lines.text: Brihat Jataka
Commentary: The principle underlying the birth so near
water is that the lagna and the chandra lagna denoting the
conditions at birth are in each case, influenced by factors
denoting water. See this principle applies in the following
shloka also:
आप्योदयमाप्यगः शशी सम्पूर्णः समवेक्षतेऽथवा।
मेषूरणबन्धुलग्नगः स्यात्सूतिः सलिले न संशयः।। 9 ।।
(ii) If there is a watery sign in the lagna and the Moon too
is located in a watery sign or
(ii) if full Moon aspects the lagna or
(iii) if the full Moon occupies 10th, 4th or the 1st house the
native will be born over water.
उदयोडुपयोर्व्ययस्थिते गुप्त्यां पापनिरीक्षिते यमे।
अलिककिंयुते विलग्नगे सौरे शीतकरेक्षितेऽवटे।। 10 ।।
Saturn occupying the 12th house from the lagna or Moon,
if aspected by a malefic planet denotes birth in prison.
(iii) Saturn occupying the sign Cancer or Scorpio in lagna
if aspected by Moon, denotes birth in a pit etc (underground).
मन्देऽब्जगते विलग्नगे बुधसूर्य्येन्दुनिरीक्षिते क्रमात्।
क्रीडाभवने सुरालये सोषरभूमिषु च प्रसूयते।। 11 ।।
Saturn occupying a watery sign in lagna:
<math>(i)</math> If aspected by Mercury denotes birth in a dancing hall.
(ii) If aspected by Sun, denotes birth in a place of worship.
(iii) If aspected by Moon denotes birth on earth.
नृलग्नगं प्रेक्ष्य कुज: श्मशाने रम्ये सितेन्दू गुरुरग्निहोत्रे।
रविनरिन्द्रामरगोकुलेषु शिल्पालये ज्ञ: प्रसवं करोति्।। 12 ।।
If Saturn occupies a human sign in lagna and
<math>(i)</math> if it is aspected by Mars, the birth takes place in or near
a burning ghat.
